_comment: The work gallery. Each entry draws an illustration until you give it a real photo: put the file in assets/ and add "photo": "/assets/your-file.jpg" plus an "alt" describing it. The moment an entry has a photo it renders that instead, and the honesty note below should come down once they are all real. Captions describe how the work is done — never claim a job that did not happen, or a place it did not happen in.
heading: What it looks like once it's in
lede: The best air conditioning is the kind you stop noticing. Where the indoor unit goes, where the pipework runs and where the outdoor box ends up are the difference between a system that disappears into the room and one you resent looking at.
note: These are illustrations, not photographs. We would rather draw what we fit than show you stock photos of somebody else's work — real pictures of our own installations replace them as the jobs come in.

items.title: Living room, 3.5 kW wall unit
items.caption: High on the wall opposite the window, so cool air travels the length of the room. Pipework drops straight through behind the unit to the outside wall.

items.title: Bedroom, 2.5 kW wall unit
items.caption: On the side wall rather than above the bed, so nobody sleeps in the airflow. Quiet mode runs at around 19 dB — below a whisper.

items.title: Kitchen extension, ceiling cassette
items.caption: Set flush into the plasterboard, blowing to all four sides. Fitted while the ceiling was open, which is far cheaper than retrofitting it later.

items.title: Rear elevation, outdoor unit
items.caption: On brackets above the extension roof, invisible from the street. Pipework boxed into painted trunking rather than left as taped insulation.

items.title: Loft bedroom, floor console
items.caption: Under the dormer, where a sloped ceiling leaves no wall tall enough for a high-wall unit. Blows warm air at floor level in winter.

items.title: Office floor, cassettes
items.caption: Standard 600 mm cassettes into the existing grid, zoned so meeting rooms and open plan run independently. Installed outside trading hours.
